## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2021-07-09: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.5 to S-1/A No. 3
- 2021-07-22: TRA executed at the closing of the Up-C reorganization, immediately prior to the IPO
- 2021-07-28: Executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.6 to the IPO 8-K (event date July 22, 2021)

#### Ongoing in-force status

- 2022-04: First post-IPO 10-K (FY2021 ending Jan 30, 2022) recognizes $92M initial FLP TRA liability (combined CLP + FLP = $153M)
- 2022 through 2026: Combined CLP + FLP liability grew to $720M at Feb 1, 2026 driven primarily by CLP-side exchange activity

## Explanation

This is the Former Limited Partners (FLP) half of Core & Main's paired Up-C TRAs, covering Pre-Merger Tax Attributes of merged blocker entities and Exchanged Owner Basis (the tax basis the blocker entities held in Holdings partnership interests, as adjusted at the time of the pre-IPO blocker mergers). The principal beneficiaries are CD&R-affiliated blocker stockholders. The payment percentage is 85% of Cumulative Net Realized Tax Benefit, coordinated with the parallel Continuing Limited Partners TRA at Section 3.3 so the combined obligations to both beneficiary groups cap at 85% of total realized tax benefit. The FLP contract has not been amended; the liability has amortized via payments as the underlying basis step-ups unwound but remains positive at the latest balance sheet date. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing record.
